entities.summary: Alexander Stewart Fitzpatrick is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He played 22 games in the National Hockey League with the New York Rangers and Minnesota North Stars during the 1964–65 and 1967–68 seasons. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1965 to 1972, was spent in the minor leagues. He was born in Paisley, Scotland, United Kingdom and raised in Dundas, Ontario.
